sources.title: 自治区发展改革委关于做好2025年电力中长期交易有关事项的通知 — 峰平谷时段按代理购电价格表注6转述
自治区发展改革委关于印发《宁夏回族自治区电网企业代理购电工作实施细则》的通知 — 2026年4月起代理购电峰平谷时段（经自治区发改委同意，按代理购电价格表注6）

notes: Source of record: nx.sgcc.com.cn col502367 monthly 代理购电价格表 PDFs (scanned images, OCR'd; every value cross-checked by the table's own formula row and the regulated 输配电价). PDFs saved via the Hark browser because the host is unreachable from the pipeline network.

Market-based TOU: 代理购电价格 differs per period (峰/平/谷 交易加权均价). No 非分时 price is published: energy_price = 平时段 total (formula 2+4+5+6+7) and purchase_price = 平时段 代理购电价格; 高峰/低谷 代理购电价格 are in data/raw/ningxia/announcements.json.

2025-11..2026-03: 峰 7-9, 17-23; 谷 9-17; 平 0-7, 23-24 (2025 periods, 宁发改运行〔2024〕952号). In 2026-01..03 the 峰 price was BELOW 平 (market outcome) — tou_order validation failures for those months are real, not OCR errors.
From 2026-04: 峰 21:00-次日5:00; 谷 9-17; 平 5-9, 17-21 (per 实施细则 宁发改价格（管理）〔2026〕79号, approved by 自治区发改委).
尖峰/深谷 not published (NULL). 单一制 需量/容量 printed as 0 -> NULL. Layout: 7 rows until 2026-07, 9 rows from 2026-08 (4th TDP period).
